# storybranch

> Alpha open-source visual testing for Storybook 10+: capture stories as PNGs, pixel-diff against baselines in git, review locally. Install `@adriangohjw/storybranch` as a dev dependency of the Storybook app.

Storybook must already be running at a URL Chromium can reach. Chromatic `modes` or `viewports` on a story become extra snapshots; both on one story is an error.

Add scripts: `visual` = `storybranch test --url <storybook>`, `visual:review` = `storybranch review`, `visual:approve` = `storybranch approve`. Run `npm run visual` (`pnpm run visual` or `bun run visual`).

`npm run visual` exits **1** when a snapshot needs attention. Failure lines: `missing baseline <file.png>`, `pixels <file.png>`, `size <file.png>`, `stale <file.png>`. A clean run prints `ok`. Inventory: `.storybranch/report.json`. The **first run** exits 1 with `missing baseline` for every shot — that is the baseline set, not a broken install.

Commit only `.storybranch/baseline/`. Ignore `.storybranch/actual/`, `.storybranch/diff/`, and `.storybranch/report.json`. Run `npm run visual:approve` only when asked to accept shots. `visual:review` and `--open` are for a person.

Install (npm): `npm install -D @adriangohjw/storybranch`, then `npx playwright install chromium`. pnpm and bun equivalents are on the site install section. Requires Bun 1.4.3+.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/adriangohjw/storybranch#readme): install, scripts, CI, monorepo development
- [Quick start](https://github.com/adriangohjw/storybranch#quick-start): scripts, exit codes, AGENTS.md snippet
- [Agent snippet on the site](https://storybook.adriangohjw.com/#agents): copy-paste `.gitignore` and AGENTS.md for your Storybook app
- [How it works on the site](https://storybook.adriangohjw.com/#how): scripts in the Storybook app
